name: diagnostics_delta
title: Diagnostics Delta
description: Capture or compare exact diagnostic occurrences for one file. Reuse the returned baseline verbatim. mode:refresh synchronizes and pulls; cached observes resident cache only. Resolved indices mean absent from a complete comparable report, never proof of a source fix. Incomplete evidence retains matches and uncertain_removed. Baselines expire on runtime/server identity changes. Source freshness is always unknown.

name: format_document
title: Format Document
description: Propose whole-file formatting as one changes document, including empty successful edits. positions_degraded:response means inexact edit columns. full defaults false; true adds exact normalized raw edits. preview.status:complete/truncated/unavailable; unified diffs have 3 context lines. Secret redaction sets redacted:true; raw edits stay exact. preview_source(origin,sha256) identifies observed bytes, not analyzed input; analysis_freshness:unknown. supplied_version preserves integer/null only when supplied. Budgets:32 files,8 MiB source+constructed text,2 s best-effort reads,100 ms off-executor diff,64 KiB display after final redaction. Limits retain edits. No writes/commands.

name: get_cached_diagnostics
title: Cached Diagnostics
description: Cached diagnostics from server notifications. Faster than the pull-model diagnostics tool, no new analysis. Errors with a retryable `ServerInitializing` while the file's server is still starting, and with `ServerFailedToStart` if it failed to start, instead of returning an empty list. `availability`: `published` (an empty list means clean), `pending` (nothing published yet) or `evicted` (a publish was dropped); an empty list next to `pending` or `evicted` is not clean. `indexing_in_progress: true` means the routed server was indexing at some point during this read, so results may be incomplete. `push_notifications_degraded: true` means the routed server crashed and was restarted, so push-only diagnostics (e.g. flycheck) are missing. `positions_degraded: "response"` (non-UTF-16 servers only) means some returned `character` offsets may be inexact.

name: get_code_actions
title: Code Actions
description: Propose range quick fixes/refactorings/source actions; resolved edits and commands are retained. A line past EOF is invalid. truncated means actions/diagnostics/edits omitted; nonempty edit.dropped means incomplete edits. positions_degraded:request means unreliable target; response means inexact edit columns. full defaults false; true adds exact normalized raw edits. preview.status:complete/truncated/unavailable; unified diffs have 3 context lines. Secret redaction sets redacted:true; raw edits stay exact. preview_source(origin,sha256) identifies observed bytes, not analyzed input; analysis_freshness:unknown. supplied_version preserves integer/null only when supplied. Budgets:32 files,8 MiB source+constructed text,2 s best-effort reads,100 ms off-executor diff,64 KiB display after final redaction. Limits retain edits. No writes; execute command-only actions outside this MCP interface.

name: get_completions
title: Completions
description: Discover API candidates in provider order at 1-based UTF-16 positions. limit is 1..100 (default 20); include_documentation defaults to false. trigger is 1..8 bytes or null. After redaction, label/detail/documentation caps are 512/2048/4096 UTF-8 bytes; labels retain payload handling. Return the longest prefix within 65536 compact JSON bytes. omitted_count/truncated/truncated_fields report local omissions/clipping. provider_is_incomplete preserves bool|null. Clipped labels are partial. Bounds exclude the LSP response. positions_degraded:request means an unreliable target. No edits.

name: get_definition
title: Go to Definition
description: Definition location of a symbol. include_source:true adds bounded five-line source or an unavailable reason; default false. Text includes start_line (1-based),origin,sha256 of complete unredacted observed bytes,shortened. Limits:100 candidates,16 files,1 MiB/file,4 MiB acquisition,2 KiB/excerpt,64 KiB final redacted text,2 MiB added JSON,2 s best-effort acquisition. Whole target-line fallback; no complete-body or analyzed-snapshot guarantee. Existing warnings remain.  Returns file path, line, and character where declared. Capped at a fixed maximum for a pathological case; `truncated: true` on the result means more locations exist than are returned. Aim it with `line` + `character`, or with `symbol_name` (optionally narrowed by `symbol_kind` and `container`) for a symbol defined in the file: the result then carries `resolved_symbol` with the position that was queried. A name matching several symbols, none, or an unverifiable position fails with the candidates or the reason instead of guessing. `positions_degraded` (non-UTF-16 servers only): `"request"` means the queried position was sent unconverted, so the result may describe a different symbol and should not be trusted; `"response"` means only returned `character` offsets may be inexact. Pass `context: "enclosing_symbol"` to attach `enclosing_symbol` to each item: `status` `resolved` (with `name_path`, `kind`, `range`, `fidelity`), `top_level` (no symbol contains it), `not_computed` or `unavailable` (with a `reason`; nothing is known, never read as top level). Costs one documentSymbol request per distinct file, capped per call; `enrichment` reports files enriched or skipped and `cut_short`. `out_of_workspace: true` means not provably inside a configured workspace root (lexical, advisory).

character.description: Character/column number (1-based). Give with `line`, instead of `symbol_name`.

line.description: Line number (1-based). Give with `character`, instead of `symbol_name`.

Pass `context: "enclosing_symbol"` to attach `enclosing_symbol` to each item: `status` `resolved` (with `name_path`, `kind`, `range`, `fidelity`), `top_level` (no symbol contains it), `not_computed` or `unavailable` (with a `reason`; nothing is known, never read as top level). Costs one documentSymbol request per distinct file, capped per call; `enrichment` reports files enriched or skipped and `cut_short`. `out_of_workspace: true` means not provably inside a configured workspace root (lexical, advisory).

name: get_references
title: Find References
description: References in server order, including duplicates. Address with line/character or symbol_name (optional symbol_kind/container). limit: 10 by default, 1..10000. Absolute lexical path_filter selects a file or descendants before normalization. matched_count counts server-response matches; truncated means matches omitted, not complete workspace coverage. Source defaults off; include_source:true opts in. With context omitted/none, default requests skip optional source and enclosing-symbol work. source.status=text has text,start_line (1-based),origin (tracked/disk),shortened; unavailable has reason. Excerpts center on the starting line with up to two lines each side. Limits: 100 candidates,16 files,1 MiB/file,4 MiB read/copy,2 KiB/excerpt,64 KiB text,2 s best-effort deadline. Pass `context: "enclosing_symbol"` to attach `enclosing_symbol` to each item: `status` `resolved` (with `name_path`, `kind`, `range`, `fidelity`), `top_level` (no symbol contains it), `not_computed` or `unavailable` (with a `reason`; nothing is known, never read as top level). Costs one documentSymbol request per distinct file, capped per call; `enrichment` reports files enriched or skipped and `cut_short`. `out_of_workspace: true` means not provably inside a configured workspace root (lexical, advisory).

character.description: Character/column number (1-based). Give with `line`, instead of `symbol_name`.

line.description: Line number (1-based). Give with `character`, instead of `symbol_name`.

name: prepare_type_hierarchy
title: Prepare Type Hierarchy
description: Prepare type hierarchy at position. Returns type items (classes, interfaces, structs) to pass to get_supertypes / get_subtypes, capped at a fixed maximum; `truncated: true` on the result means more exist than are returned. `indexing_in_progress: true`: the routed server was still indexing, so an empty or partial result may be incomplete. `positions_degraded` (non-UTF-16 servers only): `"request"` means the queried position was sent unconverted, so the result may describe a different symbol and should not be trusted; `"response"` means only returned `character` offsets may be inexact. `out_of_workspace: true` means not provably inside a configured workspace root (lexical, advisory).

HierarchyItem.description: A call or type hierarchy item.

Position2D.description: Position in a document (1-based for MCP).

PositionDegradation.description: How a non-UTF-16 server's `character` offsets became inexact in a result.

Range.description: Range in a document (1-based for MCP).

indexing_in_progress.description: `true` if the routed server reported workspace indexing in progress during this read.

items.description:
Type hierarchy items at the position, or the supertypes/subtypes of
the queried item.

positions_degraded.description: Set only when some `character` offsets are inexact (non-UTF-16 servers); omitted otherwise.

truncated.description: Whether `items` was capped below the server's full response.

name: rename_symbol
title: Rename Symbol
description: Propose a workspace rename by position or symbol_name. Resolve once; ambiguous names return candidates. Prepare on the rename server when supported. status:proposed has position,preparation,changes; not_renameable has no edits or preview. Preparation rejection stops rename; operational errors remain errors. Empty edits remain proposed. Nonempty dropped means incomplete: do not apply. positions_degraded:request means unreliable target; response means inexact edit columns. full defaults false; true adds exact normalized raw edits. preview.status:complete/truncated/unavailable; unified diffs have 3 context lines. Secret redaction sets redacted:true; raw edits stay exact. preview_source(origin,sha256) identifies observed bytes, not analyzed input; analysis_freshness:unknown. supplied_version preserves integer/null only when supplied. Budgets:32 files,8 MiB source+constructed text,2 s best-effort reads,100 ms off-executor diff,64 KiB display after final redaction. Limits retain edits. No writes/commands.

character.description: Character/column number (1-based). Give with `line`, instead of `symbol_name`.

container.description: With `symbol_name`: keep only symbols inside a container (type, impl, class, module) of this name.

full.description: Include exact normalized raw edits as well as bounded previews (default: false).

line.description: Line number (1-based). Give with `character`, instead of `symbol_name`.

new_name.description: New name for the symbol (non-blank, at most 1000 bytes).

symbol_kind.description: With `symbol_name`: keep only symbols of this kind, by name (function, method, class, struct, ...)

symbol_name.description: Name of a symbol defined in this file, instead of `line`/`character`.

name: restart_server
title: Restart Server
description: Restart LSP servers: stop the old process (graceful shutdown, then a kill of its whole process group) and start a fresh one, discarding its in-memory state. Use it when a server is wedged or serves a stale index (such as after a manifest edit). Give `servers` (ids) or `all: true`. Per server, `status` is `restarted` (with `indexing_state`; `coalesced: true` if another restart of the same server just finished; `push_notifications_degraded: true` means call it again), `failed` (with a typed `reason`; the server stays registered; `refused` means nothing was stopped and the old process keeps serving, any other reason means it was stopped and the next tool call retries), `throttled` (retry after `retry_in_ms`), `initializing` or `not_running`. Requests in flight on the old process fail with a retryable error. Processes that detach into their own session may survive; shared daemons the server started (e.g. Gradle) are killed. Destructive (it kills processes the server started, which other clients may share), not read-only and not idempotent.

all.description: Set to true to restart every configured server.

servers.description: Ids of the servers to restart; an unknown id is rejected with the list of configured ids. Non-empty.

oneOf.description: Refused before the old process was stopped, which keeps serving.

coalesced.description: Another restart of this server finished during the wait, so none was repeated.

name: workspace_symbol_search
title: Workspace Symbol Search
description: Search workspace symbols by name. Supports partial matching and fuzzy search. `limit` is capped at a fixed server-side maximum regardless of the value requested; `truncated: true` on the result means more matches exist than are returned. `positions_degraded: "response"` (non-UTF-16 servers only) means some returned `character` offsets may be inexact. `out_of_workspace: true` means not provably inside a configured workspace root (lexical, advisory). On an empty result, `index_coverage` gives `synced_documents` (documents currently synced) and `server_restarted` (once true, stays true); the server may not index other files, so not proof of absence.

kind_filter.description: Optional symbol kind filter: a name (function, class) or the numeric LSP `SymbolKind`.

query.description: Search query for symbol names (supports partial matching).

IndexCoverage.description: What an empty references or workspace-symbol answer covers.

out_of_workspace.description: Whether this location is not provably inside a configured workspace root (stdlib, a dependency).

Position2D.description: Position in a document (1-based for MCP).

PositionDegradation.description: How a non-UTF-16 server's `character` offsets became inexact in a result.

Range.description: Range in a document (1-based for MCP).

kind.description: LSP numeric symbol kind (e.g. 12 for Function).

index_coverage.description: Set only when the server itself answered with no symbols: what its answer covers.

positions_degraded.description: Set only when some `character` offsets are inexact (non-UTF-16 servers); omitted otherwise.

truncated.description: Whether more symbols matched than `symbols` returns.
